description: Return the full recipe prompt for one slug from list_prompts. Load only the recipe the agent will follow, and pass its slug as recipe on generate_persona_video. Each recipe carries the complete validated workflow: script structure and word limits, media verification via check_media for photo URLs, pricing rules for the overlay badge, and the generation and publish steps. Unknown slugs fail with the list of valid slugs — call list_prompts first when unsure.
name: get_prompt
